name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate
name_ja: Kubernetes & クラウドネイティブ アソシエイト

formal: No prerequisites; intended as a pre-professional entry credential

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Cloud-native infrastructure concepts provide an entry technical baseline, with Japanese access useful locally; no prerequisites, multiple-choice testing and limited uptake prevent an applied associate inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The proctored exam provides technical cloud-native fundamentals despite its pre-professional audience. Multiple-choice assessment, zero experience and general infrastructure coverage leave operational readiness unproven.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded cloud-native infrastructure coverage supplies technical foundations, despite the Associate title. A multiple-choice exam with no experience requirement and limited security depth does not demonstrate operational Kubernetes competence.
